meta.home: Free online tool to learn Optimization: Simplex, Transportation and Branch and Bound step by step, right in your browser.
meta.simplex: Solve linear programming problems with the Simplex (Big-M, Two-Phase and Generalized) and see every tableau and every operation.
meta.transporte: Solve transportation problems with the Northwest Corner, Least Cost and Vogel's Approximation methods, with every step explained.
meta.branchBound: Solve integer linear programs with Branch and Bound and follow the search tree, every node and every cut.
meta.simplexAbout: Understand the Simplex method: feasible region, Big-M, Two-Phase and Generalized Simplex, with examples.
meta.transporteAbout: Understand the transportation problem and the Northwest Corner, Least Cost and Vogel methods.
meta.branchBoundAbout: Understand Branch and Bound for integer linear programming: relaxation, branching and pruning.
meta.credits: About the SIMO project: authors, advisor, license and references of this Optimization teaching tool.
meta.privacy: Privacy policy: what the site stores in your browser, how we use Google Analytics and ads, and your choices.
meta.contact: Get in touch: questions, suggestions and problem reports.
